# Content Review

## POST `/api/v1/posts/{id}/submit`
Submit một immutable draft revision để Admin review
- operationId: `submitPostRevision`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`
- Request: `SubmitPostRequest` (required)
- Responses: `200` → PostResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse, `409` → ErrorResponse, `410` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse

## GET `/api/v1/posts/{id}/review-history`
Author/Admin xem status và review history
- operationId: `getPostReviewHistory`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`, `query:page (integer)`, `query:limit (integer)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → ContentReviewHistoryResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse
